# The Nanotrasen Charter of Rights This is the collection of rights, powers, and responsibilities placed by Nanotrasen upon the legal entities of the station.
## Employee Rights This charter grants the following rights to all Nanotrasen Employees in order of importance. - 1. The right to safety born of following corporate law. - 2. The right to work for the greater wealth and prosperity of Nanotrasen. - 3. The right to the aegis of department under which the employee works, should they show proper respect to their superiors. - 4. The right to a Nanotrasen appointed defender. If none is available, the member of security most involved with the arrest of the employee will be appointed as their defender. - 5. The right to a trial upon any Type 3 violation or greater, which can be deferred as long as necessary by the Head of Security.
## Prisoner Rights This charter grants the following rights to all Nanotrasen Employees as Prisoners, in order of importance. - 1. The right to medical treatment, excluding corporal punishment. - 2. The right to station communication equipment, if it is not abused. - 3. The right to food and water. - 4. The right to their shift-mandated PDA, unless tampered with. A replacement should be ordered if necessary. - 5. The right to freedom of movement within the brig. - 6. The right to a monitored consultation with the chaplain within the brig.
## Vested Powers of Security This charter grants the following powers to all Security Employees, in order of importance. - 1. The power to search the possessions of employees when not on green alert. - 2. The power to search any employee suspected of a violation regardless of alert. - 3. The power to implant any crewmate convicted of a violation with a tracking implant, and a mindshield implant if suspected to be necessary. - 4. The power of immunity against any Non-Contraband Type 1 violations or less.
## The Responsibilities of Sentencing This charter lays guidelines of the sentencing security performs, with Warden being the first to sentence, the Head of Security being second, and any other security employee available being responsible after them both. - 2. The responsibility to sentence employees convicted of a violation for the corresponding brig time. - 3. The responsibility to extend brig times according to Non-Standard Violations, where the timer will be reset to meet the new violation. - 4. The responsibility to use corporal punishment wherever necessary or practical. - 5. The responsibility to preserve the life of all those who committed Type 5 Violations under capture to be handed over for study at Centcom. - 6. The responsibility to only keep an employee in the brig for 5 minutes, unless their total violations would exceed 20 minutes of brig time, earning permanent confinement. - 7. The responsibility to offer the services of the Chaplain to those who are sentenced to execution.
## Responsibilities of Command This charter grants the following responsibilities to all heads of staff aboard the station, in order of importance. - 1. The responsibility for heads of staff to lead their departments efficiently. - 2. The responsibility for heads of staff to keep hold upon their Nanotrasen appointed equipment. - 3. The responsibility to obey all Corporate Law that pertains to them. - 4. The responsibility, as an acting head of staff, to hand over all trappings of the position to a Nanotrasen appointed head of staff if they arrive later.
## Rights of Command This charter grants the following rights to all members of command aboard the station, in order of importance. The immunity clause does not apply to acting heads of staff. - 1. The right to not be prosecuted for Non-Contraband Type 1 Violations under any circumstance. - 2. The right to not be prosecuted for Non-Contraband Type 2 Violations within their own department. - 3. The right to fire any employees from their own department at will, as well as hire any Nanotrasen employees to their department. - 4. The right to utilize security to enforce their command of their department.
## Mandate of the Captain This charter grants the following powers to the captain, in order of importance. The immunity clause does not apply to an acting captain. - 1. The mandate of immunity against Type 3 Violations and below, excluding Contraband Violations. - 2. The power to override any decision made aboard the station. - 3. The mandate over departments such that the Captain’s orders override that of any head of staff, inheriting all rights and powers that involve any department. - 4. The mandate over execution, such that all executions unless otherwise specified in corporate law must first be authorized by the captain. If there is no captain, authorization goes to the Head of Security, and then the Acting Captain.
## The Rights of the Chaplain This charter grants the following rights to the Nanotrasen approved Chaplain of the station. - 1. The right to worship Nanotrasen-approved deities. - 2. The right to offer religious service to those sentenced to execution or confined within the station brig. - 3. The right to involve themselves in the capture of any magically-inclined taboo beings, to be overriden by any member of security. If said entity is a Nanotrasen Employee, the Chaplain must be properly deputized by Security. Not doing so may result in a vigilantism charge. - 4. The right to conduct Nanotrasen approved religious rites within the station chapel.
